start_here: Say to your AI: "Measure how fast this video starts: https://example.com/share/abc/shr_key". It runs tool:measure-first-frame with that address, opens a real browser on your computer, and tells you the first frame, Play-to-moving and seek times against the old files path's speed.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it plays one address in a browser on your computer and answers the numbers; it keeps nothing.
instructions: 1. Make sure this computer has Chrome or Chromium (or Playwright's Chromium); for an MP4 that needs H.264 name your Chrome in browser_path.
2. Say "Measure how fast this video starts" with the address of a video a browser can play by Range, such as a share link or a file's byte route.
3. Read the medians and against_bar: within true means the old files path's speed was met, false means it was missed, null means that number could not be measured (error says why).

worked_examples.title: A shared video against the bar
worked_examples.ask: Measure how fast this shared video starts, 3 samples.
worked_examples.given: A video at that address that answers Range requests with 206.
worked_examples.hands_back: {host: "example.com", medians: {fresh: {first_frame_seconds: 2.1, bytes: 9000000, ...}, returning: {first_frame_seconds: 0.5, ...}}, against_bar: {fresh: {first_frame_seconds: {value: 2.1, at_most: 5.9, within: true}, ...}}}
